title: Habitat hunt recording table
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 26 (Habitat hunt recording table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 26: Habitats near home. To understand that a habitat gives living things what they need to survive

questions.q: A woodlouse needs damp and dark. Where would you look?
questions.model: Match the need to the place: damp and dark. Under a log is shaded and damp. So look under a log or a stone.

questions.q: Name two things a habitat gives an animal.
Do a 5-minute habitat hunt with an adult (garden, park or window box). Record each living thing and where you found it.
questions.a: A table of 3 or more living things with places, e.g. worm: soil; snail: under a pot
questions.model: Teacher shows a photo of a log, lists 'woodlouse: under the log, damp and dark' in the table.

questions.q: Why did you find more creatures in some places than others?
questions.a: Damp, dark, sheltered places have more food and protection

questions.q: How would a garden habitat change in winter?
questions.a: Colder, fewer leaves and insects; some animals hide or sleep

questions.q: A habitat gives food, water and...
Big question: why are woodlice under a damp log?
questions.a: The log gives the damp, dark shelter they need to survive.
